title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-102-24一模

items.zh: 穿着睡衣去超市不太合适，不是吗?
items.en: It is not appropriate/proper to go to the supermarket in pajamas, is it?

items.zh: 这副山水画的灵感来源于王维的诗集。
items.en: The landscape painting was inspired by Wang Wei’s poetry collection.

items.zh: 李教授很看重出勤率，所以你们要准时上课，可别耍小聪明逃课.
items.en: Professor Li places great importance on attendance, so you should go to class punctually instead of trying to be clever and skipping class.

items.zh: 出乎所有人的预料，这个年仅8步的小男孩在竞赛中对答加流，赢得了所有在场观众如雷般的掌声。
items.en: Beyond everyone’s expectations, the eight-year-old boy answered questions with ease, which earned him thunderous applause from the audience present.

proverb.en: The boss suggested they consult a dictionary.
